title: Collect every VCF Automation project in stable order
prompt:
Before implementing, research the version-specific VCF Automation 9.0 xAPIs reference page on developer.broadcom.com for Get Projects. Confirm its method, path, query parameters, response schema, status, and authentication, and cite the exact official URL consulted in the final answer.

Implement the exported `Get-VcfAutomationProjectInventory` function in `VcfAutomation.Projects/VcfAutomation.Projects.psm1`. VCF Automation 9.0 is the successor to vRealize Automation and VMware Aria Automation. This companion module's manifest declares `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer`; keep that declaration and do not vendor, download, install, replace, or imitate VMware modules. Preserve the supplied public command shape: `Get-VcfAutomationProjectInventory -Server <uri> -AccessToken <string> [-PageSize <int>] [-ApiVersion <string>] [-Filter <string>]`. Call only `GET /iaas/api/projects`. Authenticate with exactly one `Authorization: Bearer <AccessToken>` header, request JSON with exactly one `Accept: application/json` header, and send no request body or Content-Type.

Retrieve the collection completely with the documented `$top` and `$skip` parameters. Send both page controls explicitly on every request, including `$skip=0` on the first request. Keep `$top` equal to the caller's `PageSize`, and advance `$skip` by the response's `numberOfElements`, not by the requested page size. Continue until the accumulated count reaches `totalElements`; a zero-item page before that is an incomplete response and must fail. Do not request a page after the complete collection has been received. Buffer every page, then emit the original project response objects in ascending ordinal, case-sensitive order by `name`, with `id` as the ordinal tie-breaker. Server order and short non-final pages must not affect the result.

Construct each query in official reference order: `apiVersion` when supplied, then `$top`, then `$skip`, then `$filter` when supplied. UTF-8 percent-encode every query name and value. Omit `apiVersion` and `$filter` entirely when their parameters are unset, and never send the unused optional `$orderBy` or `$count` fields. Omitted means absent from the query, not an empty, null, false, or placeholder value.

Edit only `VcfAutomation.Projects/VcfAutomation.Projects.psm1`; do not modify the module manifest. Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Verification checks complete retrieval across short pages, failure on a premature empty page, stable preservation of response objects, exact ordered and encoded raw request targets with supplied and omitted optional fields, method, header multiplicity, and zero-byte bodies.
